goal: Deliver the approved DocForge Markdown-to-Word workbench from visible UI through regression, visual QA, macOS packaging, installation, and Microsoft Word preview verification.
non_goals: Do not rename the repository, Python package, CLI, Tauri bundle identifier, domain types, protocol, or template IDs.
Do not change Markdown parsing, domain, compiler, RenderPlan, DOCX renderer, OOXML, final preview generation, or transport DTO semantics.
Do not add AI, accounts, cloud sync, collaboration, analytics, a template marketplace, a new editor, a new icon package, dark mode, i18n, or WPS behavior.
expected_evidence: Focused component and reducer regression tests
Frontend lint, typecheck, unit, build, browser E2E, and real HTTP E2E output
macOS release build and installed application evidence
Microsoft Word final preview path verification
Task report, spec review, quality review, and SpecNav verification evidence
unsafe_assumptions: Visible DocForge branding does not authorize internal ThesisForge identifier changes.
Moving the Word template selector must not change template IDs, reducer state, or transport callbacks.
A passing frontend build does not prove mobile navigation, installed app freshness, or Microsoft Word preview behavior.
Prototype fixtures and hard-coded content are not production implementation.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation requires changing backend or document semantics, adding a new architecture decision, editing outside the allowlist, or cannot preserve existing transport and mobile/resizer behavior.
